About Pocket Arcade

Six browser games built for our Web Programming course.

What happens to my scores?

Memory Match keeps your best round while its page stays open. Leaving or reloading clears this progress. Finished rounds save automatically in this browser. The score sheet shows them, accepts your own entries and can be printed. The home page shows your game records.

Built for the Web Programming course

We built the site with HTML, CSS and JavaScript, without libraries or frameworks. JavaScript handles the game boards and saves completed scores in your browser.
